name: io.github.RostislavMatov/mcpcut
title: mcpcut
description: Proxy for any MCP server: journals tool calls with secrets redacted, holds risky calls for approval

packageArguments.name: --server
packageArguments.description: A short name for the wrapped server in the journal and the approval queue, e.g. fs
The command that starts the MCP server to put behind mcpcut, e.g. npx
Its arguments, one per value, e.g. -y, then @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem, then your project path
